messages:
Alex W: Heads up: I'm drafting an "export-lease" design for SIEM artifact exports that ties KMS unwraps to a short-lived entitlement. Goal: safe, auditable, auto-purgeable exports. Opening for quick feedback before I file the PR.

Mira S: quick q  who initiates the lease in normal ops? analyst UI, oncall, or an automated detection rule?

Alex W: primary flow = analyst UI form -> ticket -> lease minted via our lease service (STS-style creds) -> export job uses lease to unwrap via KMS and push to whitelisted storage. For external partners there's an extra legal check.

Sam T: prototype notes: prefer ephemeral service account via STS assumeRole. Add IAM condition on KMS key requiring claim export_tag=="analyst-approved" and require unwrap caller to include export_id in request metadata. Example IAM condition snippet:

```yaml
condition: "request.auth.claims.export_tag == 'analyst-approved' && request.time < timestamp('2026-01-01T00:00:00Z')"
```

Also log these fields on unwrap: export_id, ticket_id, principal, key_version, client_ip.

Rachel P: compliance asks: ledger must be append-only; every grant/deny, lease creation, and unwrap must land in SIEM with immutable references. Exports must carry headers: X-Export-ID and X-Purge-After. External consumers: require signed retention SLA + envelope key that we can revoke.

secbot: auto-checklist: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/export-lease-checklist 
- ephemeral SA <= 24h
- KMS key policy requires export_tag
- ledger retention >= 7 years for forensic cases

Mira S: who runs the purge job? ops owns infra deletions but we need the export request form to include desired retention so purge is deterministic. Ops: can you confirm automated DAG will handle deletes?

opsbot: deploy-bot: airflow dry-run completed in staging: purge DAG identified 37 objects for deletion, simulated deletes OK. CI log: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/6789 :white_check_mark:

Sam T: ledger schema proposal (plain JSON string stored in DB and mirrored to SIEM):

"{\"export_id\":\"ex-2026-004\",\"requester\":\"Mira S\",\"lease_expiry\":\"2026-02-10T08:00:00Z\",\"kms_tag\":\"sensitivity=analyst-approved\",\"buckets\":[\"siem-exports\"],\"audit_ref\":\"log://unwind/9999\" }"

Rachel P: rollout plan suggestion: security sandbox for 2 weeks with internal-only consumers, TTL=4h, auto-purge enforced. If stable, widen to partners with contract + legal signoff. Also require security review approval before enabling external exports.

Alex W: two open items I want input on: (1) Should the KMS IAM condition check request origin (ip/region) for internal analysts? (2) Per-partner KEKs vs per-export envelope keys?

Mira S: origin checks are noisy for analysts (remote/home VPNs), so avoid strict ip checks for internal use. For external partners go with per-export envelope keys to reduce key sprawl and make revocation trivial.

Sam T: Agreed: envelope keys for external. Keep internal flow light: tag + ephemeral SA + ticket binding. Also add a lifecycle key-rotation playbook for suspected compromise: revoke SA, rotate wrapping key, trigger re-encrypts if needed.

Rachel P: PR acceptance criteria for security review: audit fields present on unwrap calls, append-only ledger with immutability guarantees, purge DAG validated in staging, runbook updated, and legal signoff for external SLA. Tag me and sec when the PR is ready.

Alex W: Thanks. I'll prepare PR with YAMLs (IAM + KMS conditions), ledger schema, and airflow DAG diff. Will include a short canary test plan. Tagging @Rachel P and @secbot on open. :rocket:

Mira S: please include test cases for failure modes: lease denied, KMS unwrap fail, purge job downtime, and partial upload.

Alex W: adding tests now. planning to open PR today.

Rachel P: acked, will review promptly.
